nominees.name: Madam Shiro
nominees.desc: She's basically calm and understanding. Takes her time to ensure you've grasped whatever is being taught. Never dismissive. She teaches International Humanitarian Law and International Environmental Law. Keen with her work. I don't remember cases of missing cat marks during her time. Also she always uploads CAT marks on time.
nominees.category: BEST LLB LECTURER OF THE YEAR

nominees.name: Mr.Osino
nominees.desc: Mr George Osino transforms the classroom into a dynamic highly interactive learning arena. He is characterized by an exceptional commitment to cover every topic with an inspiring world class mindset. By constantly reminding his students they are fully equal to Harvard law students and other top Law schools he builds fierce academic confidence and empowers them to stand proudly on the global stage
nominees.category: BEST LLB LECTURER OF THE YEAR

nominees.name: Mr.Mwangi
nominees.desc: Mr. Mwangi is an exceptional lecturer whose dedication to his students goes far beyond academics. In the classroom, he regularly shares invaluable life and career encouragement to prepare students for the professional world. Outside lecture halls, he serves as a mentor, offering guidance on personal matters, serving as a trusted CV referee, and actively recommending students for opportunities. Mr. Mwangi is not just an educator, but a lifelong career coach.
nominees.category: BEST LLB LECTURER OF THE YEAR

nominees.category: BEST LLB LECTURER OF THE YEAR

Just perfect

nominees.name: Karen Muchunku
nominees.desc:
KAREN MUCHUNKU | DIPLOMA 2.2 CLASS REPRESENTATIVE 

Leadership is not just about holding a position; it is about service, commitment, and making every voice count.

As the Class Representative for Diploma 2.2, I believe in clear communication, listening to students' concerns, advocating for our needs, and representing my classmates with integrity, responsibility, and dedication.

I strive to be approachable, accountable, and committed to ensuring that our voices are heard and our concerns addressed. For me, leadership is about putting people first and working together towards a better student experience.

❤️ I don't just represent a class; I stand for its voice, its needs, and its progress.

nominees.name: John Elvis Nyoike
nominees.desc:
multi-talented professional who bridges the gap between law and digital storytelling. As an Future Advocate of the High Court, a Law student, he brings sharp analytical skills, legal expertise, and a dedication to justice to his professional practice.
Complementing his legal background, John Elvis is a highly influential digital creator. By combining legal precision with award-winning communication skills, he has built a powerful reputation for making information accessible, engaging, and impactful.

nominees.name: vincent vutiya
nominees.desc:
VOTE VINCENT MUCHIKA VUTIYA
MOST INFLUENTIAL STUDENT OF THE YEAR
Influence is not just about being known; it is about standing for something, inspiring others, and making a difference.
I stand for purposeful leadership, integrity, student empowerment, and a generation that refuses to be limited by circumstances. I believe our influence should create opportunities, inspire confidence, and leave a positive mark on the people and communities around us.
This nomination is bigger than an individual. It represents the importance of our voices, and the potential we have to shape a better future.
Your vote is your voice. Let us make it count.
Influence with Impact.

Your vote is more than support; it is a vote for positive change, student empowerment, and a stronger student community. Together, we can make a difference!

nominees.name: Njenga Annsylvia
nominees.desc:
🔥 WHY NJENGA ANNSYLVIA FOR BLOGGER OF THE YEAR? 🔥

I’m Njenga Annsylvia, the CS for Research & Innovation at RVNP, and I’m passionate about using my voice to inform, inspire, engage, and tell stories that connect with people. 📝✨

My strengths? Creativity, consistency, compelling storytelling, fresh ideas, and the ability to turn information into content people actually want to read! 🚀

I don’t just blog — I create conversations, share ideas, and give people a reason to stay informed. 💯

If you believe in my voice and my passion for blogging, I’m asking for your vote for Blogger of the Year! 🗳️🏆

Njenga Annsylvia — your voice, your stories, your vote! 🔥
